quarterly_data.quarter: Nitto Boseki semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-10-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: First half to September 30, 2025: net sales JPY 57,412 million (+8.2% YoY), operating profit JPY 9,454 million (+28.7%), ordinary profit JPY 9,159 million (+18.6%) and profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 6,878 million (+27.1%); management states sales of high value-added products were strong, led by the Electronic Materials business. H1 group R&D expenses JPY 1,540 million.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 net sales JPY 57,412 million (+8.2%); operating profit JPY 9,454 million (+28.7%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Nitto Boseki semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-10-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Electronic Materials segment, first half to September 2025: net sales JPY 23,418 million (+19.3% YoY) and operating profit JPY 8,986 million (+40.2%). Management states strong demand for AI servers continued, and sales of low-dielectric special glass and of low-thermal-expansion special glass for semiconductor package substrates were strong.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 Electronic Materials net sales JPY 23,418 million (+19.3%); operating profit JPY 8,986 million (+40.2%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Nitto Boseki semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-10-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Other segments, first half to September 2025: Medical net sales JPY 6,760 million (-3.2%), operating profit JPY 1,086 million (-20.4%), hit by China's growing preference for domestic products and inflation; Composites net sales JPY 6,856 million (+5.0%), operating loss JPY 137 million (loss of JPY 668 million a year earlier); Materials and Chemicals net sales JPY 4,514 million (-0.8%), operating profit JPY 224 million (-16.3%); Insulation net sales JPY 7,294 million (-3.3%), operating loss JPY 209 million (operating profit JPY 352 million a year earlier) on weak housing sales and periodic-repair costs; Other net sales JPY 8,567 million (+9.7%), operating profit JPY 279 million (+30.7%).
quarterly_data.figure: Medical JPY 6,760 million; Composites JPY 6,856 million; Materials and Chemicals JPY 4,514 million; Insulation JPY 7,294 million; Other JPY 8,567 million
